description: Use when the user asks how often an NFL, NBA, NHL, MLB, WNBA or college football player has reached a stat number recently, e.g. 'how often has Cade Cunningham scored more than 24.5 points in his last 10 games'. Returns last-5 and last-10 counts for a player's stat lines, the last-5 values and the average. Pass `line` to check any number against recent games. Describes past games only. It is not a prediction or a recommendation.

stat.description: Stat key or words, e.g. 'pts', 'points', 'rec_yds', 'receiving yards', 'shots'
